permissions.label: Open ML Studio
permissions.description: May open ML Studio at all (portal menu entry); also reads the UCS connection status.

permissions.label: View dashboard
permissions.description: Dashboard page: recent activity, training activity, compute spend, pending-promotion count.

permissions.label: View model overview
permissions.description: Model Overview page: per-model monitoring, drift, timeseries, explainability, governance, model alerts.

permissions.label: View model catalog
permissions.description: Model catalog page: registered models, base-model library, algorithms, a model's governance.

permissions.label: Train models
permissions.description: Train wizard and build actions: create, retrain, complete and cancel training runs; HPO searches and promoting their best trial; experiments; pipeline definitions, running and restarting pipelines; editing a model's description; test predictions and artifact download.

permissions.label: Train on large GPU profiles
permissions.description: May launch training on the gpu-4x and gpu-8x compute profiles (GPU quota). Needs mlstudio:train:run as well.

permissions.label: View datasets
permissions.description: Datasets page: datasets, snapshots, previews and downloads, comments, audit log, sharing list, Iceberg catalogs.

permissions.label: Manage datasets
permissions.description: Create, edit, delete datasets; upload files, pull Iceberg snapshots, delete snapshots; comment; share and revoke access.

permissions.label: View pipelines
permissions.description: Pipelines page: pipeline runs and definitions, training runs and their detail, the worker fleet.

permissions.label: View endpoints
permissions.description: Endpoints page: serving endpoints and their health.

permissions.label: View experiments
permissions.description: Experiments page: experiments and HPO searches.

permissions.label: Deploy and promote
permissions.description: Deploy & promote page: deployments, pending promotions, promote and roll back a model version; change endpoint rate limits and regenerate an endpoint's client secret.

permissions.label: View alerts
permissions.description: Alerts page: alert policies, active alerts, alert history, notification channels.

permissions.label: Manage alerts
permissions.description: Create, change and delete alert policies and per-model overrides; acknowledge and resolve alerts; evaluate alerts now; manage Slack/Teams notification channels.

permissions.label: View cluster monitoring
permissions.description: Cluster monitoring page: compute-pool occupancy and cluster telemetry.

permissions.label: Sync base models from UCS
permissions.description: Refresh the base-model library from the Unified Catalog Service.

permissions.label: Delete models
permissions.description: Delete a registered model. Declared for the Admin Portal; no route in this release performs it yet.

permissions.label: Share models
permissions.description: Share a registered model. Declared for the Admin Portal; no route in this release performs it yet.

permissions.label: Approve compute requests
permissions.description: Approve GPU/compute quota requests. Declared for the Admin Portal; no approval workflow exists in this release yet (large GPU profiles are gated by mlstudio:gpu:train-large).

permissions.label: Write monitoring data
permissions.description: Post ground-truth feedback for a prediction and trigger production telemetry collection (API only; no page uses it).
